source.branch: A non-lit, non-timed, non-globby ordinary scroll is dropped by a hero standing on pool terrain but not yet Underwater, outside shops/shipping/trap/region/special-pile limits. C extracts it, then flooreffects water_damage with force FALSE decides blanking before ordinary placement; JS preflight blocks all liquid terrain before extraction.
callers: do.c:dodrop -> drop preserves canletgo/can_reach_floor, prints drop message, sets how_lost, then calls dropx. dropx785-797 freeinv precedes ship_object/altar and dropy -> dropz -> flooreffects. Existing js/do.js preserves this source ordering after successful preflight; callers are unchanged.

Existing preflight_dropx is shared with direct dropx/dropz and hold_another_object/reverse_loot callers. Reconcile its narrow paper-on-pool policy without broadening those owner functions or claiming unrelated active drop callers. Source-required ordinary placement uses existing dropCommandEnv hooks.

Detached floor object has in_invent false, so no fade message/update_inventory here. Broader acid/container/book/default erosion callers remain outside this bounded admission credit.

Retain all shop/trap/region/timer/light/glob guards and source ordering; new admission requires both the liquid check and ordinary-terrain whitelist to agree on the supported pool-scroll case.

B169 still holds exact source:do.c:dropx through immutable delivery e0bbc19f. Its occupied-pit admission is separate but must be preserved; no source claim or game edit during this investigation. Resume only after acceptance/merge or explicit coordinator approval of dependent continuation.
